'''Nicholas Corda''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with CESD Talent Agency and Impressive Talent Casting Agency.

==Biography==
Corda was born on July 7, 1992, and grew up on Long Island. He became a voice actor as an adult and joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced {{an|Mallow}}'s older brother [[Ulu]]. He currently lives in New York City.
